findings.detail: Stored cost for AGY Holdings Corp. Delayed Draw Term Loan is 3,247,998, but the June 30, 2024 investment schedule shows amortized cost 36,725,695 and fair value 33,346,945.

rationale: The X07 warning is a true data error: the extracted row used cost 3,247,998 with fair value 33,346,945, creating an artificial greater-than-10x fair-value-to-cost ratio. The raw schedule row for the same issuer and instrument shows amortized cost 36,725,695 and fair value 33,346,945, so the fair value is source-supported but the stored cost is wrong.
